packages.label: קִנְאַת ה' וּצְדָקָה
packages.reason: These two concepts share the same essential spiritual nature: an act of fiery devotion to God's honor (קנאה) is structurally equivalent to an act of tzedakah. Both represent the channel through which a person elevates and sanctifies the world — one through passionate defense of God's name, the other through material generosity. The Rebbe's source (Tosafot on B.B. 10b, the case of Nevuzaradan) demonstrates that the act of 'being zealous for God' constitutes tzedakah in the fullest sense; they are two expressions of the same reality of sacred self-giving.
